Reviews and Testimonials for Majestic Home Solutions
From our first meeting with Zayne we knew Majestic was the right partner for us. The design phase was great and we couldn’t be happier with the finished product. Our basement is beautiful! The timeline was met, the work is stellar. We would hire them again for sure!
-
Jennifer H
|
Majestic did a great job remodeling our Master Bath. Project was on time (completed in 30 days) and on Budget. Craftsmen were very professional and courteous. Also, had great suggestions on enhancements as we went through the process.
-
Steve O
|
Couldn't be happier with the work and quality of work performed by Majestic. Our lower level was transformed from a dull and dreary storage area to a beautiful recreation area: Kitchen & Bar area; Buffet & Dining area; Full Bath and an Entertainment area with a Natural Gas Fireplace. The workers were very accommodating to our schedules, cleaned up any and all debris left over and were congenial and very easy to work with. Zayne helped immensely with the Kitchen design and layout as well.
-
Gary M
|
Zayne and his crew were timely, professional and respectful during the entire process! I could not be happier with the way the basement turned out and I would recommend Majestic to anyone!
-
Tom K
|
Zayne and his team did a fantastic job with our kitchen and 2.5 bath remodel. We hired Majestic Home Solutions to finish our project after the first company we hired failed to be competent. Zayne took our nightmare situation and turned it into a great experience. We received high quality craftsmanship and product. This five star company was professional, honest, reliable, competent, respectful, and knowledgeable. We highly recommend hiring Majestic Home Solutions!
-
J Jones
|
We were very lucky having found Majestic Home Solutions. Guys did a wonderful job re-modeling all bathrooms in our house. We liked it so much that we hired them to do the make over of the kitchen with laundry and family room next year. Now it’s a brand new house. The quality of workmanship was outstanding, prices were reasonable, as well as time line. We would recommend their services to anybody interested.
-
Mark B
|
We recently had our lower level finished by Majestic Home Solutions and as I look back on the whole project this would be my summary: The planning and layout was a joint venture between Majestic and my wife and I. Their suggestions on how to maximize the space we were finishing worked our very well. The kitchen and bar area including the cabinets turned out to be exactly what we were hoping for. The project was completed in less time than was estimated and the quality of the workmanship was excellent.
-
Thomas A
|
Zayne and his team are amazing. Every time I call Zayne with a new idea, he is able to translate my vision into a design. His attention to detail is superb and he is very trustworthy. I highly recommend Majestic.
-
Kelly A
|
Zayne and team were great from design to build to finish work they exceeded expectations. They took our ideas and truely went above and beyond to make them reality. If something wasn't quite right they made sure to fix the issue to our satisfaction, easily the best contractor we've hired. We now have a wonderful basement living space for our family to enjoy and can't thank you enough for making it a great experience.
-
Matt K
|
Hello, My name is Joe and I am the owner of The Carpet Guys, LLC. My company has been providing the floor covering for Zayne's customers for the last few years. My company does work for many of the medium to large home improvement contractors and builders throughout Metro Detroit and I hear all the stories from just about every single perspective as to how the homeowner feels about their general contractor. I will say that Majestic Home Solutions has by FAR the best feedback out of everyone that we do business with. When I arrive at a home to conduct a measure for the new carpeting, not only does the project look amazing to begin with, but the homeowners are ALWAYS raving about how great Zayne and his crews are. They are both neat and clean as well as professional and polite. What I really like is the creative eye that goes into the planning of his finished basement designs. I've done carpet for well over 100 different projects for Majestic and not once has there been two basements that look exactly alike. Zayne makes the best use of the space in ever situation and he just seems to have an artistic knack that really sets his jobs apart from every other builder or re-modeler that we do business with. If you are looking for a top notch looking finished basement, I would definitely check out what Zayne can do for you.
-
Joe
|
Zayne did wonderful job on a laundry/mud room and bathroom remodel. He was very timely and high quality craftsmanship. Would recommend Majestic Homes to anyone without hesitation. Can’t wait to start the next project with him.
-
Brian S
|
